Based on the extracted customer order data from the Magento admin report, I have analyzed which customer has completed the most number of orders in the entire history. Here are the totals per customer across all years (2013, 2022, 2023):

1. John Smith: 11 orders (all in 2022)
2. Grace Nguyen: 10 orders (all in 2022)
3. Jane Smith: 12 orders (3 in 2013 + 9 in 2022)
4. Matt Baker: 9 orders (all in 2022)
5. Samantha Jones: 8 orders (all in 2023)
6. Sarah Miller: 15 orders (8 in 2022 + 7 in 2023)
7. John Doe: 5 orders (all in 2013)
8. Rack Fox: 3 orders (all in 2013)
9. Mark Woodland: 3 orders (all in 2013)
10. Jane Doe: 3 orders (all in 2013)
11. Alex Johnson: 7 orders (all in 2023)
12. Michael Nguyen: 6 orders (all in 2023)
13. Bob Jones: 5 orders (all in 2023)

The customer with the most number of orders is Sarah Miller with 15 total orders (8 in 2022 + 7 in 2023).
